finding.text: The intro paragraph on /framework/core/Item/Dated/ names a long literal path (`public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/20/index.jsonl`) that breaks across two lines at 400 (words 2) — shots/…Item-Dated/400.png, intro band; a shorter "today's index file" with a link would read cleaner.

The page opens on a wall of code before the live demo, and the demo shows only "no project rows today yet" until the button is pressed (page 1, content) — shots/…Item-Dated/1200.png; the one takeaway is clear only after a click, so show an example row or the empty state with a one-line "press the button".
At 400 the code box is clipped on the right with no visible scroll cue (layout 3) — shots/…Item-Dated/400.png; layout.json overflow_x false, so it is contained, just truncated.
layout.json wraps lists the shell's `drawer-rail-ai` "✦AI" button at 3.2 lines at 400 — chrome, not part of this diff.
`move` takes `{from, module, apply}`, not the plan's `move(item, to)` — deviation is logged in Server/doc/dated-files.md, and keeps `move_project`'s inputs intact.
A 404 resource error appears at all four widths on /framework/core/Item/Dated/ (layout.json errors) — likely a missing file the page or its shell requests; find which and fix or declare it.

At 1200 and above the page is 57-69% empty (layout.json empty 0.568 / 0.594 / 0.693): the one-paragraph intro and the demo code block sit in a narrow column while the code block fills the wide space. Acceptable for a doc page, but the demo itself ("Make a demo project") is small and low on the page, below the code (shots/.../1200.png, bottom band).

The first paragraph carries a long file path in inline code ("public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/20/...", widest_text 337px at 400); it did not overflow (overflow_x false) but is the widest line at every width.

Only one of the requirement checkboxes is visible to this review: the dev-server-dependent demo button cannot be verified from shots, and the diff shows the button's error text asks to restart the dev server to load `dated_create`.
